name: @clossys/customer

capabilities.subQuestion: Would the named audience actually keep this, first-person, one keep or fail before seal or land?
capabilities.worldClass: Every candidate gets one independently observed, first-person, append-only keep-or-fail verdict from someone actually inhabiting the named audience — never a self-assessment by the role that built it, never overwritten once recorded.

capabilities.subQuestion: What does lived, first-person feedback on this surface actually say, on any topic asked?
capabilities.worldClass: First-person feedback is functional and experiential, on-demand on any topic — never limited to a fixed rubric or a canned survey question.

capabilities.subQuestion: How does this compare to the alternatives this person actually considered, from their own consideration set?
capabilities.worldClass: A comparison is always against the person's own real alternatives — never a generic competitor list assembled by someone else.

capabilities.subQuestion: Would this person actually refer someone else, and in what words?
capabilities.worldClass: A refer verdict states, in the person's own words, whether and how they would actually refer someone — never an assumed net-promoter score.

capabilities.subQuestion: What would make this person leave?
capabilities.worldClass: A churn verdict names the specific, first-person condition that would make this exact person leave — never a generic churn-risk score.

capabilities.subQuestion: What would it take for this person to actually start?
capabilities.worldClass: An adopt verdict names the real, first-person condition that would move this person from considering to starting — never an assumed funnel step.

capabilities.subQuestion: Is this worth what it costs this person?
capabilities.worldClass: A worth verdict weighs the actual cost against the actual value, first-person — never a generic willingness-to-pay guess.

description: The customer role: first-person synthetic inhabit of the named audience — keep, lived feedback on any topic, comparison from their consideration set, referral, churn, adopt, and worth. Job: if I am the person this was made for, do I keep this?
author: Clossys
